role: sound listening test, source sa3 (Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX Base)
summary: All 72 candidates (4 families x 3 prompts x 6 seeds) made at 44.1 kHz stereo, 50 steps, cfg 7, euler, with the prefix 'TrackType: SFX, '. The same seed gives bit-identical output (checked on the card and against the file on disk); another seed differs. Each clip takes about 2 s after a first call of 18 s (warm-up); peak graphics memory 2.28 GB. 47 of 72 files have at least one sample at full scale: the makers' generate() clamps to [-1,1] before returning (at most 0.09 percent of samples in any file).

settings.sampler: euler, given explicitly (the card's stable-audio-tools example names euler; the library default for this model's objective is pingpong)
settings.apg_scale: 1.0, library default, not set by the card
settings.duration: the family's seconds passed as seconds_total (3, 2, 4, 3); the library generates duration+6 s internally (duration_padding_sec 6.0, default) and cuts to the asked length
settings.dtype: float16 on cuda (as the card does)
settings.prefix: 'TrackType: SFX, ' before every prompt. The makers' prompting guide (docs/guides/prompting.md in their repository) recommends it for sound effects; neither the base model's card nor the guide says anything specific about the base checkpoint, so it is applied on the strength of the guide only. The text really given is in text_given of every item.
settings.seed: seed argument of generate(): torch.manual_seed(seed), then torch.randn for the noise. Confirmed: the same seed twice gave bit-identical arrays (max abs diff 0.0), equal to the file on disk; seed 12 against 11 differs by up to 0.79.
settings.output: 2 channels, 44100 Hz, written as float32 WAV untouched; the channels differ (max left-right difference above 1.3 in every family), so it is real stereo

sizes.venv_total_du: 11 GB for .venv-sound/sa3 including weights and src
sizes.free_disk_after: 526 GB of 1.9 TB (543 GB before the first install)

safety.pickles: svd_bases.pt is a pickle file. The adapter never loads it: the makers' code only reads it for -XS LoRA adapters, which are not loaded here. Checked once for this report: torch.load(..., weights_only=True, mmap=True) succeeded and returned a dict of 193 tensors keyed model.model.* (nothing but tensors, no allow-list needed). The makers' own calls pass weights_only=True (stable_audio_3/models/lora/loader.py line 91, bake_dora.py line 128), so no shim was needed. Model weights come from model.safetensors and the T5Gemma model.safetensors.
safety.telemetry: grep of stable_audio_3 (without training) for analytics, telemetry, posthog, sentry, requests, urllib, urlopen, httpx, socket found nothing. huggingface_hub has an opt-out usage ping (utils/_telemetry.py), switched off by HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1; generation runs with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 (set by the adapter itself), so nothing is fetched at run time.
safety.gated_repository_shim: The base checkpoint's model_config.json names its text encoder as subfolder t5gemma-b-b-ul2 of the GATED sibling stabilityai/stable-audio-3-small-sfx. The adapter patches that conditioner config in memory (drops repo_id and subfolder, sets model_path to the t5gemma-b-b-ul2 folder of the base repository, which holds an encoder of the same name). The sibling was never contacted.
safety.other: a Hugging Face token file of the user exists in the home directory; it was not used (token=False, HF_TOKEN unset, offline mode).

problems: The makers' generate() clamps its output to [-1,1]. 47 of 72 raw files contain samples at full scale (gear 13 of 18, hull 10, shield 11, thruster 16); the largest share of samples at full scale in any file is 0.09 percent (shield). The adapter does not change what the model returns, so the clipping is in the files; screen.py should treat it as a measured property.
The first generation of a run took 18 s (warm-up), the rest 1.6 to 2.8 s each; total generation time 155 s, model load 21 s.
The prefix 'TrackType: SFX' could not be confirmed as specific to the base checkpoint.
